newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo to sell 2nd issue of 200 mln dinar T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yugo to sell 2nd issue of 200 mln dinar T-bills.

text.p: The Yugoslav government decided on Thursday to launch a second issue of Treasury bills worth a total of 200 million dinars ($35 million), independent news agency Beta reported.
The bills will be put on sale on July 10 and will carry a 3.5 percent monthly interest rate, Beta quoted a Federal Information Ministry statement as saying.

The bills will be issued in three tranches -- the first 50-million dinar tranche will mature in 30 days, the second also a 50 million dinar tranche in 60 days and the third 100 million dinar tranche in 90 days.
The government did not say what the funds from this issue of T-bills would be used for.
The first issue of 30- and 60- day government T-bills worth a total of 100 million dinars were put on sale on May 12 to finance the army's lilabilities with commercial suppliers.
It was sold out in the week ending June 27, Belgrade bourse sources reported. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 311 4305
